title: Comparatives & superlatives
summary: Use comparative forms to compare two things and superlatives for the highest degree in a group.

explanation.en: Short adjectives usually take -er/-est. Longer adjectives usually use more/most.
explanation.ru: Короткие прилагательные обычно получают -er/-est, длинные — more/most.

examples.en: This car is faster than that one.
It is the most interesting place here.
Tom is as tall as Ben.
examples.ru: Том такой же высокий, как Бен.

forms.label: Irregular
forms.pattern: good → better → best · bad → worse → worst

commonMistakes.note: Do not use more with an -er comparative.
Use -est with short adjectives such as tall.
